    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrRead`, s.`Phone`
    FROM satscores AS ss
    INNER JOIN schools AS s ON ss.cds = s.`CDSCode`
    WHERE s.`District` = 'Fresno Unified'
),

    SELECT cds, `AvgScrRead`, `Phone`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `AvgScrRead` IS NOT NULL
),

    SELECT r.cds, r.`AvgScrRead`, r.`Phone`
    FROM c_rows r
    ORDER BY r.`AvgScrRead` ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT `Phone` FROM t_join;

WITH c_district AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 LIKE '%South Bohemia%'
       OR d.A3 LIKE 'South Bohemia%'
       OR d.A3 LIKE '%South Bohemia'
       OR d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
       OR d.A3 LIKE '% South Bohemia %'
       OR d.A3 LIKE '% South Bohemia'
       OR d.A3 LIKE 'South Bohemia %'
),
c_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
    FROM c_district d
    JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
),
c_account AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM c_client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
),
c_card AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM c_account a
    LEFT JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.card_id IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM c_card;

    FROM cards

WHERE af.`artist` = (SELECT `artist` FROM min_artist);

    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.`attribute_name` = 'Speed'
),

    SELECT s.id, s.`superhero_name`, s.`publisher_id`, ha.`attribute_value`

    WHERE a.`attribute_name` = 'Speed'

    FROM c_rows r

)
SELECT `publisher_name`

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT p.Id AS PostId, p.ParentId, p.Score, u.DisplayName AS OwnerDisplayName
    FROM posts AS p
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT PostId, ParentId, Score
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE Score IS NOT NULL AND Score > 0
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT c.PostId, c.ParentId, c.Score, u.DisplayName AS OwnerDisplayName
    FROM c_rows c
    INNER JOIN users u ON c.ParentId = u.Id
),
t_filter AS (
    SELECT PostId, ParentId, Score, OwnerDisplayName
    FROM t_join
    WHERE ParentId IS NOT NULL
),
t_max_score AS (
    SELECT PostId, Score
    FROM t_filter
    ORDER BY Score DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT t.PostId, t.ParentId, t.OwnerDisplayName
    FROM t_max_score m
    INNER JOIN t_filter t ON m.PostId = t.PostId
)

    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.q2
    FROM qualifying AS q
),

    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.q2
    FROM c_cols q
    WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.q2, d.surname
    FROM c_rows q
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
),
t_filter AS (
    SELECT t.driverId, t.surname, t.q2
    FROM t_join t
    WHERE t.raceId = 19
),
t_min AS (
    SELECT driverId, MIN(q2) AS min_q2
    FROM t_filter
    GROUP BY driverId
),

    SELECT driverId, MIN(min_q2) AS best_lap_time
    FROM t_min
    GROUP BY driverId
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT t.driverId, d.surname
    FROM t_best_lap t
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON t.driverId = d.driverId
    ORDER BY t.best_lap_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT surname
FROM t_final;

972.sql:
WITH t_join AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.code, r.fastestLapTime
    FROM drivers AS d
    INNER JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
),
t_fastest AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, fastestLapTime
    FROM t_join
    ORDER BY fastestLapTime ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT driverId, code
FROM t_fastest;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM races AS r
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM c_cols r
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM c_rows r
),
t_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races
    FROM t_join
),
final_answer AS (
    SELECT total_races / 10.0 AS annual_average
    FROM t_count
)
SELECT annual_average
FROM final_answer;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT m.league_id, l.name
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
),
c_count AS (
    SELECT league_id, name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY league_id, name
),
c_max AS (
    SELECT name, MAX(match_count) AS max_matches
    FROM c_count
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT name, max_matches
FROM c_max
ORDER BY max_matches DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH t_join AS (
    SELECT p.`player_name`, pa.`heading_accuracy`
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
    WHERE p.`height` > 180
),
t_agg AS (
    SELECT `player_name`, SUM(`heading_accuracy`) AS total_heading_accuracy, COUNT(`player_name`) AS count_players
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY `player_name`
),
t_avg AS (
    SELECT `player_name`, 
           CAST(total_heading_accuracy AS REAL) / count_players AS average_heading_accuracy
    FROM t_agg
)
SELECT `player_name`, average_heading_accuracy
FROM t_avg
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

944.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT r.`raceId`, r.`time`, r.`position`, d.`forename`, d.`surname`, r.`fastestLapTime`
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 121
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `time`, `position`, `fastestLapTime`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `position` = 1
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT r.`time` AS champion_time, l.`time` AS last_driver_time
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN results AS l ON r.`raceId` = l.`raceId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 121 AND r.`position` = 1 AND l.`position` = 5
),
c_time AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS champion_seconds,
        CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 1, INSTR(last_driver_time, '+') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS last_driver_seconds
    FROM t_join
),
c_percentage AS (

WITH c_rows AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
),
t_filter AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis
    FROM c_rows p
    INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1980' 
      AND (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%' 
           OR p.Diagnosis LIKE 'RA%' 
           OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA' 
           OR p.Diagnosis = 'RA' 
           OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA susp%' 
           OR p.Diagnosis LIKE 'RA susp%')
),
cte_sex_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_count
    FROM t_filter
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM t_filter
)
SELECT (100.0 * female_count / total_count) AS percentage
FROM cte_sex_count, total_count;

1467.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, b.spent, e.event_name
    FROM budget AS b
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) AS total_spent
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, b.spent, e.event_name
    FROM budget AS b
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
),
t_event AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.link_to_event, e.event_name
    FROM t_join t
    INNER JOIN event e ON t.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_spent) AS total_amount_spent, event_name
    FROM c_rows
    INNER JOIN t_event ON c_rows.link_to_event = t_event.link_to_event
    GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT total_amount_spent, event_name
FROM final_result
ORDER BY event_name;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`
    FROM c_cols t
    WHERE t.`Price` IS NOT NULL AND t.`Amount` IS NOT NULL
),
fuzzy_currency AS (
    SELECT c.`CustomerID`, c.`Currency`
    FROM c_rows t
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.`CustomerID` = c.`CustomerID`
    WHERE 
        c.`Currency` LIKE '%Euro%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE 'Euro%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%Euro' 
        OR c.`Currency` = 'Euro' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '% EUR%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE 'EUR%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%EUR' 
        OR c.`Currency` = 'EUR'
),
t_total AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price` * t.`Amount` AS total_price
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.`CustomerID` IN (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM fuzzy_currency)
)
SELECT AVG(total_price) AS answer
FROM t_total;

    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`
    FROM c_cols t
    WHERE t.`Price` IS NOT NULL AND t.`Amount` IS NOT NULL
),
fuzzy_currency AS (
    SELECT c.`CustomerID`, c.`Currency`
    FROM c_rows t
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.`CustomerID` = c.`CustomerID`
    WHERE 
        c.`Currency` LIKE '%Euro%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE 'Euro%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%Euro' 
        OR c.`Currency` = 'Euro' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '% EUR%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE 'EUR%' 
        OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%EUR' 
        OR c.`Currency` = 'EUR'
),
t_total AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price` * t.`Amount` AS total_price
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.`CustomerID` IN (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM fuzzy_currency)
),
final_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_price) AS answer
    FROM t_total
)
SELECT * FROM final_avg;
